importSubtitle: Choose an .actweave.yaml file. Import writes drafts only; it never tests or publishes.
dropHint: Drop a file here, or click to choose. YAML, 5 MiB max, no secrets.
fileHint: YAML, 5 MiB max. No secrets. Connections match by provider name and connection alias.
canImport: Validation passed. Drafts can be written.
cannotImport: Some items cannot be imported. If the package is from another workspace, remap providers/connections to this workspace and retry.
remapHint: The package does not have to come from this workspace. Map each source provider/connection to a connection here, then import.
remapNeedConnection: This workspace has no service connections yet. Create one before remapping the import.
sameSlugHint: You can import into another workspace. If there is no provider with the same name, remap to a local connection. An existing slug updates the draft only; published versions stay unchanged.
reasonProviderMissing: No provider with this name in the current workspace. Remap to a local connection.
reasonConnectionMissing: No connection with this alias in the current workspace. Remap to a local connection.
reasonConnectionAmbiguous: That connection alias matches more than one connection. Choose the target by ID.
reasonBindingMissing: The remapped target connection was not found.
reasonSlugProviderConflict: This slug already exists under a different provider, so it cannot be imported.
reasonConnectionRequired: A connection alias is required, or remap to a connection in this workspace.
reasonMissingInWorkspace: This workspace is missing a dependency: {detail}
